en: Hello and welcome to this course. My name is
Manuel and I'll be your instructor. You
probably know that you can write prompts in
ChatGPT and get an answer. In this course,
we will go way beyond that. We will use
ChatGPT as a full AI workspace, working with
documents and projects, doing proper
research, generating images, and analyzing
data. And yes, that includes having ChatGPT
generating and analyzing Excel files and
creating presentations for you. One thing
worth mentioning upfront: this is a
business-focused course. The examples shown
revolve around real business scenarios like
finance, reporting, or business
communication. So we won't dive into
personal to-do lists or hobby projects.
Everything you learn relates directly to the
work you actually do. A quick tip before we
directly start: This is a hands-on course,
so I highly recommend to follow along in
your own ChatGPT. The prompts I use are
attached to the lectures so you can try
everything on your own. So let's now dive
into the course with a modern ChatGPT
interface tour. And let's also have a look
at some of the most important settings.
